messages:
ashwin: Heads up — nightly perf CI is at 86% S3 quota because we kept full nsys traces for every job. We need a pruning policy and smarter capture rules.
liam: Ugh. I was seeing that in the dashboard. Some runs are 1.2GB each.
ashwin: (typo) meant ashwin — agree. We should only keep full traces for failing/regressing commits and keep a small sampled profile for green runs.
sara: +1. Sampling could be: 1/50 green runs, and always keep for builds with metric delta > 3%.
maria: What metric? Token latency P95 or kernel occupancy?
ashwin: Start with end-to-end token P95 and kernel-level self time for the top 3 kernels. If diff shows >3% regress on either, mark run as "retain-full-trace".
liam: Can bench-bot annotate runs with those metrics?
bench-bot: bench-bot: added automation stub — nightly-run 02:00 UTC -> computes token_p95, kv_warmup_time, top_kernels (by ms). Tagging runs now. :gear:
ashwin: For capture rules, propose:
- green & not-sampled: run lightweight perfetto + aggregated counters (small JSON)
- green & sampled or failing/regressing: run nsys with `--trace=nvtx,cuda,nvtx_mem` and collect kernel timeline (full `.qdrep`).
- failing/regressing: also upload raw `.nsys` and `nvprof` outputs for deeper debugging.

liam: Need to limit per-repo bucket size. We should implement lifecycle rules: compressed traces expire after 90d, summaries kept 365d, regressions pinned until manually closed.
sara: +1 on pinned regressions. Also add an automated email to assignees when a regression is pinned.
maria: What about artifact naming and reproducibility? We should include commit sha, model id, batch_shape, seq_len, kv_enabled flag.
ashwin: Agreed. Example S3 key: `ci-traces/{repo}/{yyyymmdd}/{commit_sha}/{model}-{batch}x{seq}-kv{on|off}-{nsys|summary}.qdrep`
liam: We should also store a tiny manifest JSON with: kernel selector choice, batching heuristic params, quantization profile id, env (cuda/drivers), and seed. That makes diffs meaningful.
bench-bot: bench-bot: adding `manifest.json` to artifacts for future runs.
liam: For the CI job, here's the capture snippet I tested locally:```bash
# run warmup
python -m bench.run --model resnetlike --batch 8 --seq 1024 --warmup 20
# perf capture (conditional in CI)
nsys profile -o $OUTDIR/run --trace=nvtx,cuda -f true --capture-range=nvtx --stop-on-exit true --env "CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0" --force-overwrite --duration 60s 
# export summary
nsys stats $OUTDIR/run.qdrep --report gpgpu --output $OUTDIR/run.stats.json
```

sara: We need to ensure CI runner image has nsys + matching driver/toolkit or capture fails silently. Add validation step that checks `nsys --version` and `nvidia-smi`.
ashwin: Good point. If mismatch, we fall back to perfetto-only and mark capture as partial in manifest.
maria: For the diff dashboard: show token P95 trend, top kernel self-time trend, and an overlay of kv-cache hit rate. Allow clicking a point to fetch the full qdrep for that commit (if retained).
liam: Also add an automated heatmap generator that extracts kernel timelines from qdrep and stores a compressed PNG for quick triage (small, cacheable).
ashwin: Storage/pruning policy proposal (initial):
- summaries (json, png) -> keep 365d
- sampled qdrep (1/50 green) -> keep 90d
- full qdrep for regressions/fails -> keep until manual close
- raw nvprof/nsys raw files -> keep 30d unless regression
- total bucket soft limit 500GB per-repo, run LRU prune older non-pinned traces when exceeded.

sara: Edge case: intermittent regressions from noisy benchmarks. We should require regression to persist for 3 consecutive CI days before auto-pinning. Otherwise just alert and sample more traces.
liam: Nice. Also add a flag to force retention in PR description: `[retain-trace]` to help ad-hoc debugging. CI should parse PR body.
bench-bot: bench-bot: implemented parsing for `[retain-trace]` in PRs.
nashwin: Who will own the retention pr? I can draft a PR to the CI infra repo with lifecycle rules + capture toggles. Need someone to review the S3 IAM changes.
maria: I can review S3/IAM.
sara: I'll own dashboard wiring (diff endpoints + pin UI).
liam: I'll own the CI capture stubs and nsys validation container updates.
devops-bot: devops-bot: created ticket INFRA-742: "ci: autotrace retention + selective capture" and assigned to @liam, @maria, @sara, @ashwin. Link: https://tracker.redwood.ai/INFRA-742
ashwin: Awesome. Next steps: liam + maria + sara to sync tomorrow 10:30 PT to split work. If we can land basic pruning before next weekly perf run, we avoid immediate overage.
liam: I'll send calendar invite.
sara: Thanks all.
bench-bot: bench-bot: nightly job will switch to sampling=1/50 starting next run unless overridden. :white_check_mark:
